description: Contract pin updates for a sysspec implementation. Copy into the implementation repo and replace every orders with the service name and every hungovercoders/sysspec with the spec repo's owner/repo: sed -i '' -e 's/orders/orders/g' -e 's|hungovercoders/sysspec|hungovercoders/sysspec|g' renovate.json. One-time setup: install the Renovate app and enable 'Allow auto-merge' on the repo, with branch protection requiring the contract-converge check.
